stories.title: Recent ZyXEL Switch Vulnerability Exploited by Chinese Hackers

stories.title: New Linux Kernel Flaw Gives ARM64 KVM Guests Read-Write Access to Host Memory
stories.description: A Linux KVM flaw on ARM64 can expose host kernel memory to guests and enable guest-to-host escape when nested virtualization is enabled.

stories.title: WordPress Patches ‘Click2Shell’ Vulnerability
